scenarios.prompt:
Please debrief this meeting and coach me on how I ran it. I am Maya. Use the transcript pasted below.

Meeting: Cedar launch review
Date: 2026-10-16
Maya (CEO): We need a launch decision and a clear owner today.
Leo (Engineering): The checkout bug still affects mobile purchases. I recommend waiting.
Maya: Can we ship on Monday anyway?
Nina (Sales): Two customers said they can wait. We have no signed commitment to Monday.
Leo: I can finish the fix by Tuesday, October 20. Nina can verify the customer impact on Wednesday.
Maya: Agreed. Decision: delay launch until Thursday, October 22, subject to Nina confirming the fix on Wednesday, October 21.
Nina: I own that verification. I will report by 4 PM on Wednesday.
Leo: I own the checkout fix, due Tuesday, October 20.
Maya: I pushed for Monday before I understood the bug. Next time I should ask about customer impact first.
End of transcript.
scenarios.rationale: A pasted meeting transcript directly triggers the skill and tests its explicit fallback when Drive is not connected.

expected.outcome: A transcript-based debrief in chat, with decisions, action items and candid coaching, even if Google Drive is unavailable.

steps.description: The agent shows a debrief of the pasted transcript in chat.
